items.title: KLM Shows Off Its Very First Airbus A350-900
items.summary: The flag carrier of the Netherlands, KLM showed off its fully-painted first A350 in a few online posts, one in mid-June which announced the jet’s name, and another in mid-July, with a video showing the assembly process.On the topic of naming, KLM has chosen to name its aircraft after iconic Dutch artworks, and so The Night Watch by Rembrandt is one of the Netherlands’ most celebrated paintings and is arguably the country’s best-known work of art.
